label: D1 step late in the episode (trial >= ~70)
explanation: Fires only at the D1 (fixation) step, never at GO or D2, and only late in the episode: rate is ~0 before trial 30, rises through trials 50-69 and plateaus at ~31-33% of all steps (i.e. nearly all D1 steps) from trial ~70 to 99. It is an episode-time / end-of-episode clock, not a task-variable feature: rates are flat across previous reward, transition, choice, stay/switch, good state and core pattern. It correlates with low model value (value < 7.13 gives F1 0.86) because the value head falls as the episode nears its end. Misses are mostly weak activations on D1 steps at trials ~50-69 (ramp-up); false positives are late D1 steps where it is silent. ep_trial >= 65 trades precision for recall (F1 0.856). Magnitude was not systematically checked beyond the top quartile being 91% covered by the predicate.

issues: Minor imprecision about the plateau: the rate is not flat from trial 70. In dev it is 0.262 of all steps (about 79% of D1 steps) at trials 70-79, then 0.329 (about 99% of D1) at 80-89 and 0.311 (about 93% of D1) at 90-99. So 'levels off from about trial 70' should read 'from about trial 80'. The rise is gradual, and it explains the precision of about 0.90.
Checked and true: the feature never fires at GO or D2. (phase != D1) & (ep_trial >= 70) scores 0 on test, and GO/D2 carry 0 activations in dev.

Checked and true: there is no task-variable structure inside the predicate. Precision of D1 & ep_trial >= 70 stays at 0.89-0.91 when split by good state, previous action, upcoming action, previous reward, short vs long time since reversal, and start_high. Rates are also flat across core_pattern, common, stay and next_stay.

Checked and true: the misses are mostly the ramp. Dev recall from D1 steps at trials 50-69 is 0.13, at precision 0.20, so they cannot be added without losing F1. Misses (test) and false positives look like weak or near-threshold activations, not a separate class.

Checked and true: the test scores reproduce (P 0.899, R 0.837, F1 0.867, mass recall 0.895), ep_trial >= 65 gives test F1 0.854, and D1 & value < 7.13 gives dev F1 0.863. Neither value thresholds nor value-and-trial combinations beat the trial predicate on F1 (best 0.863 or lower).
